name: xsvg
description: eXtensible SVG — an XML graphics format that compiles to plain SVG, with the text layout, warps, and gradient meshes SVG never got.

scripts.wasm:node: wasm-pack build crates/xsvg-wasm --release --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/xsvg-compile/pkg && rm -f packages/xsvg-compile/pkg/.gitignore && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > packages/xsvg-compile/pkg/package.json
scripts.ext:build: cargo build --release -p xsvg-ext-clipart --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p packages/xsvg-viewer/ext && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/xsvg_ext_clipart.wasm packages/xsvg-viewer/ext/clipart.wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/xsvg_ext_clipart.wasm dataset/clipart.wasm
scripts.dev: npm run wasm:dev && npm run ext:build && vite
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && npm run ext:build && vite build && npm run build:embed
scripts.sync:readme: cp README.md packages/xsvg-viewer/README.md && cp README.md packages/xsvg-compile/README.md && cp README.md crates/xsvg-cli/README.md && cp README.md crates/xsvg-core/README.md && cp README.md crates/xsvg-wasm/README.md && cp README.md crates/gradient/README.md
scripts.build:packages: npm run sync:readme && npm run wasm:build && npm run wasm:node && npm -w @visioncortex/xsvg-viewer run build && npm -w @visioncortex/xsvg-compile run build
scripts.check:incremental: npm run wasm:node && npm -w @visioncortex/xsvg-compile run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/incremental-check.mjs
scripts.check:dom: npm run wasm:node && npm -w @visioncortex/xsvg-compile run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/dom-patch-check.mjs
